NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL

UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-6833; MEETING
ID: 835 6094 1558; PASSCODE: 522537 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY
BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 5:00 p.m. on November 23, 2020 in the City Council Chambers, Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk
Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

  (Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the items listed)

CALL TO ORDER  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL  City Clerk

Dated this 20th day of November 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC, City Clerk
   City Council Agenda Report
  November 23, 2020

TO:  Honorable City Council

FROM:  Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager

BY:  John P. Ramirez, Director of Community Development
  Glen W.C. Kau, P.E., Director of Public Services/City Engineer
  Christine Roberto, Public Services Manager

SUBJECT:  PROJECT NO. 7858 - AWARD OF CONTRACTS – CITY HALL
  REMODEL  PROJECT  FOR  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  DEPARTMENT AND ENGINEERING DIVISON

Background:

In September 2020, staff contracted with SVA Architects to re-design office, meeting
room, and common areas in the Community Development Department and Engineering
Division to update mechanical systems and reduce the number of open office areas in
order to create a safer environment for employees in response to the COVID-19
Pandemic.

The scope of work includes moving Engineering Division staff to Room 11 where Housing
Division is currently located, adding thirteen individual offices for Community
Development Department staff, expanding the small conference room near the
Engineering Division with access from both Departments and creating a large conference
room at the west side of City Hall in the area near the entry doors. Since this effort will
utilize Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act funds, the project
needs to be completed by December 30, 2020 in order to be eligible for reimbursement.

On November 20, 2020, seven bids were received for the project with the following
results:

  Bidder  Bid Amount
 MTL Construction Services, Inc.  $277,299.30
 SAS Construction  $370,198.00
 SD Design Construction Corp.  $372,000.00
 MLC Construction Inc.  $406,500.00
 City Council  November 23, 2020
Award of Contracts – City Hall Remodel, Project No. 7858  Page No. 2

 Urban Professional Builders Inc.  $444,000.00
 KG Axis Inc.  $503,250.00
 MIK Construction Inc.  $559,207.00

MTL Construction Services, Inc. of Anaheim submitted the lowest responsive and
responsible bid. The contractor recently completed services for cities of Placentia and
Upland. Staff has checked references and confirmed a valid contractor’s license.

In addition to the construction work, staff desires to amend the contract with SVA
Architects to assist with project management and consultant work due to the stringent
timeline and ability to quickly assess any required changes or adjustments to the project.

  Construction  $ 277,299.30
  Contingency (20%)  $ 55,460.00
  CM/Inspection  $ 8,850.00
  Design Services  $ 32,960.00
  Asbestos Testing  $ 1,200.00
  Total Estimated Project Costs:  $ 375,769.30

Fiscal Impact:

Work will be funded through CARES Act funds received by the City to address
COVID-19 related issues. The total budget allocation is $350,000; $300,000 from the
CARES Act and $50,000 from the Housing Authority’s CARES Act funds dedicated to
improvements for the Housing Authority staff office area and public counter/conference
room spaces.

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Action Plan Implementation:

The recommended action will further the City’s strategic plan goal(s) of: (6.E.) Improve
parks, public facilities, and open space and identify opportunities to enhance community
resources.

Recommended Action:

Staff recommends City Council:

  a. approve an amendment to the contract with SVA Architects, Inc. for construction
  management and consulting services in the amount of $8,850.00;

Award of Contracts – City Hall Remodel, Project No. 7858  Page No. 3

  b. approve a contract with MTL Construction Services of Anaheim for construction of
  office, meeting room, and open spaces for the Community Development
  Department and Engineering Division in the amount of $277,299.30;

  c. authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments, change
  orders or extensions provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City,
  in a form approved by the City Attorney.
